title: The rikma's code
intro: Connect the rikma's GitHub repositories. The code stays on GitHub; 1lev1 records whose work it is.
connectTip: On GitHub you can choose “Only select repositories”. Either way, you then pick here the one repository that joins the rikma — nothing else is connected.
manageAccessTip: To add repositories you left out when installing. After saving on GitHub you come back here to pick one.
notConfigured: The GitHub integration is not set up on this server yet.
empty: No repository is connected to the rikma yet.
disconnectConfirm: Disconnect {{repo}} from the rikma? The installation on GitHub itself stays in place.
issuesHint: An issue labelled {{label}} opens as a task in the rikma. When it is closed on GitHub the rikma is told, and when the task is marked done a comment is left on the issue.

pick.title: Which repository joins the rikma?
pick.intro: GitHub gave access to {{count}} repositories. Pick one to connect — you can connect another one later.
pick.empty: GitHub did not give access to any repository.
pick.manage: Check on GitHub which repositories the App may reach
pick.missing: Don't see the repository? Grant it access on GitHub

status.connected: The repository is connected to the rikma.
status.conflicts: This repository is already connected to another rikma, so it was not moved.
status.taken: This GitHub account is already linked to another 1lev1 account.
status.denied: The authorization on GitHub was cancelled.
status.invalid: We could not verify the request. Please start again.
status.expired: Too much time passed. Please start again.
status.wrongUser: The connection was started by a different user. Please start again.
status.noInstallation: No installation came back from GitHub.
status.failed: Something went wrong with GitHub. Please try again.

account.title: GitHub account
account.desc: Linking your account lets rikmas recognise your contributions to their code. Only your GitHub id and username are stored, never your email.

work.title: Work on GitHub
work.intro: Merged PRs and the reviews on them. Whoever did the work can file hours for it, and the rikma approves them like any timer hours. Lines of code never become a share.
work.failed: Could not read the work from GitHub. Try refreshing.
work.empty: No merged PRs in the connected repositories yet.
work.mineOpen: {{count}} pieces of your work can be filed as hours.
work.linkFirst: For the rikma to recognise your work, link your GitHub account.
work.unlinked: Not linked — the work is waiting for them
work.notMember: Not a member of the rikma

claim.mission: Which of your missions is it for?
claim.hours: How many hours did the work take?
claim.suggestion: Suggested from the size of the change: {{hours}} h. Only a starting point — you decide.
claim.alreadyLogged: You already have {{hours}} h on timers tagged with this work. File only hours that were not measured.
claim.consent: The hours go to the rikma’s usual approval: approve, discuss or counter — and silence until the response time is consent.
claim.noMissions: You have no open mission in this rikma. Filing hours needs a mission first.

errors.notConfigured: The GitHub integration is not set up on the server.
errors.invalidHours: The number of hours is not valid.
errors.notConnected: The repository is no longer connected to the rikma.
errors.notYourMission: The chosen mission is not yours in this rikma.
errors.notFound: The PR was not found on GitHub.
errors.notYourWork: According to GitHub this work is not yours.
errors.notMerged: The PR is not merged yet.
errors.alreadyClaimed: You already filed hours for this work.

badge.title: README badge
badge.intro: Paste it into the repository’s README. It shows that this is a rikma, how many partners it has and how to join, and links to the rikma’s page.
